resources.name: Physical constants for Fe-57 in Be

access.notes: Standard literature values: Debye temperature of Be (Θ=1160 K), mass of Be (9.012 u), mass of Fe-57 (57 u), gamma-ray energy of ⁵⁷Fe (14.4 keV). These are public knowledge and can be used directly.

resources.notes: No special dataset required; the computation uses only these known constants.
